highlights: Detached house in popular village to edge of Lake District National Park
summary: Found in this popular village to the fringe of the Lake District National Park, handy for Pooley Bridge and Penrith, a well-proportioned, 2 double bedroomed, detached house, set in a quiet cul-de-sac, providing flexible, reverse accommodation, with private enclosed garden to rear.
description:
Offered to the market with no ongoing chain, and found in good order, but in need of some updating and priced accordingly, an interesting opportunity to acquire a deceptively spacious, detached home, located in a quiet cul-de-sac in a peaceful residential area of this always sought after village to the edge of the Lake District, within easy reach of Penrith [3.5 miles] and Pooley Bridge and the Ullswater Valley [3 miles].

Sat in a generous plot, with off road parking to the front leading to the garage, and with a well-stocked private garden to the rear, the accommodation comprises to the ground floor the main entrance hall, master bedroom, with adjoining dressing room / study and Jack and Jill ensuite 4 piece bathroom, and a utility room with separate WC.

To the first floor is an open plan living dining room, with front to rear aspect, separate kitchen and the second bedroom, which has an ensuite shower room.

Perfect for an easy renovation, the property would lend itself to remodelling to create additional bedroom space if required, and should be viewed to fully appreciate.

Directions From Penrith take the A6 south to Eamont Bridge. Once in Eamont Bridge at the mini roundabout turn right signposted Pooley Bridge. Follow this road for approximately three miles into Tirrell. Pass the Queens Head public house, take the 2nd right into Thorpefield. Follow this to the end to reach number 14 on the right hand side.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric, water and drains being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking.
